records.summary_text: Brunei's Sharia Penal Code contains one of the world's most explicit trans-specific criminal provisions: Section 198 creates an offence of "a man posing as a woman or vice versa", and the Bruneian government has confirmed in its official guidance that the code applies to all persons in the country including tourists — travel agents are briefed accordingly. records.name: Portugal
records.summary_text:
Portugal remains one of the world's safest destinations for transgender visitors. The 2018 self-determination law allows legal gender and name change without medical requirements (minors 16-17 with parental consent), bathroom access matching one's gender is legally protected, conversion therapy is banned (2024), intersex infant surgery is banned, and hate-crime law covers gender identity — within an EU rule-of-law environment with very low violent crime.
